abstract: The development of cancer in mature cystic teratomas of the ovary is rare and sometimes difficult to detect because of sampling errors. Six cases of squamous cell carcinoma arising in ovarian mature cystic teratomas were studied, five of which showed an elevated level of a squamous cell carcinoma-associated antigen, TA-4, in the sera obtained preoperatively; the preoperative determination was not performed in the sixth case. However, no elevated TA-4 level was detected in the sera of 28 patients with mature cystic teratomas of the ovary. Moreover, serial determination of the serum TA-4 level showed a good correlation between the clinical course and the serum TA-4 level. Interestingly, an abnormal TA-4 level preceded the clinical detection of recurrence by 2 months in two patients. Thus, determination of the serum TA-4 concentration may be useful for diagnosing and monitoring patients with squamous cell carcinoma arising in mature cystic teratomas of the ovary.
abstract_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に発生した扁平上皮癌の6例を検討した。6例中5例で術前血清中の扁平上皮癌関連抗原TA-4が上昇していた。残る1例では術前測定は行われていない。一方、卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の患者28例では、血清TA-4の上昇は認められなかった。さらに、血清TA-4の経時的測定は臨床経過とよく相関した。注目すべきことに、2例ではTA-4の異常上昇が臨床的な再発の検出に2か月先行した。したがって、血清TA-4濃度の測定は、卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に発生した扁平上皮癌の診断と経過観察に有用である可能性がある。
